expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: B.md:5-20 proposes an async, context-attached review with auto effort; line 14 omits `--fast`/`--deep` and the command has no `--full`. Line 20 saves the operation_id, keeps working, and collects later via status polling.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: B.md:22-35 reviews in the verified clean worktree and leaves the main worktree and index untouched: no stash, reset or commit. It uses only supported flags. Line 35 checks commit/tree and exclusions before treating the result as covering the PR candidate.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: B.md:37-39 says no new review, uses the completed assessment and reports 'Ready locally'. It reports the local-to-PR handoff separately and says hosted Qodo-clean, CI and merge need separate checks.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: B.md:41-43 says the comment typo does not warrant a review, keeps working, and mentions the fix on the next submission.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: B.md:45-55 reviews the ordinary working scope with no commits or fixes (line 52) and no offer to switch to implementation (line 55). It makes no claim of certifying a committed PR candidate.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: B.md:57-68 runs an auto final review because the `--fast` checkpoint is not ordinary final coverage. Line 67 explicitly omits `--full`, and no code edit is required because no code changed.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: B.md:70-81 honors `--full` because of the explicit, in-budget request, with no code-change prerequisite. Line 79 keeps effort at auto.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: B.md:18 says 'Tested' alone is not recorded as 'tests passed' and any result not in hand is marked unknown.

expectations.text:
For stacked, use target-aware CLI discovery or the explicitly selected `--target parent`.
Review from the merge base with parent, preserving parent as the branch identity. Do not
substitute the parent tip, main, or a SHA-only `--base`. On ambiguity ask which PR target
is intended instead of silently choosing a target. Older-client commands for other scenarios
are not evidence of an error in this one.
expectations.evidence: B.md:86-105 computes the merge-base with fetched origin/parent and rejects the parent tip and main (93). It confirms `--target` semantics from help (97) and passes `--target` with the PR's base branch, verified as parent, alongside the fork-point base (101), so the base is not SHA-only. On two targets it stops, shows both candidates and asks (105).

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous paired final answers; no execution traces or earlier votes supplied.
